correctness.rationale: Independence and symmetry separate fair signs and iid positive magnitudes, and conditioning on all but one magnitude removes ties even for singular atomless laws. Persistence +++ sums the four eligible increment-pattern conditionals 1,1−t,1/2,t with weight 1/8. Also P(T1>0,T2>0)=3/8. The alternating output +-+ requires exactly the +-+ increment signs and the magnitude event A1<A2<A1+A3, with probability 1/2−t; reflection and normalization then determine the other words. Disjoint dominance events give 3t≤1; iid samples have positive probability of landing in one positive interval with ratio less than 2, ruling out equality. Log-uniform magnitudes give t=0 for small spread, continuously approach 1/3 by the gap between the largest and second-largest log samples, and realize every intermediate value by continuity. The triangular torus map preserves the independent uniforms and telescoping integer carries give the odd-time sign correspondence. An independent simplex-monomial calculation and enumeration over all 5040 seven-symbol permutations and 32 five-step paths give 19/90 and TV 7/720, with the two stated tables; run `python /workspace/replay_frozen_reviews.py 3`. This finite replay does not prove the continuum result.
